race.description: Book A Round At The Gatton Jubilee Golf Club Mdn Hcp
race.comment: DENVER BRONCO (1) has upside from a fair Gold Coast debut and can improve second-up, although 1400m is new and the wide draw with top weight leaves him with more to answer. STOLEN STOCK (15) is the main danger after resuming with a close fourth at this track, where he was held up from the 250m and finished just over a length from Flying Vision. His long maiden record is a knock, yet his latest effort reads well for this. SLAYRIDER (12) is building through the campaign and hit the money at Kilcoy despite being slow away, with solid place records at this track and around the distance. ELLOFABY (10) is close to a win placing at last couple, the latest finishing a nose second at this track and drops in the weights for this. Settles back early but winds up late. Watch for a big run.
